state.description: Indicates the state of the counterparty.

created_at.description: The date and time the counterparty was created in [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

updated_at.description: The date and time the counterparty was last updated in [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

accounts.description: The list of public accounts associated with this counterparty.

cards.description: The list of cards associated with this counterparty.

BankCountryCode.description: The country of the bank, provided as a 2-letter [ISO 3166](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_ISO_3166_country_codes) code.

id.description: The ID of the counterparty's account.

account_no.description: The bank account number of the counterparty.

iban.description: The IBAN number of the counterparty's account if applicable.

sort_code.description: The sort code of the counterparty's account if applicable.

routing_number.description: The routing number of the counterparty's account if applicable.

bic.description: The BIC number of the counterparty's account if applicable.

clabe.description: The CLABE number of the counterparty's account if applicable.

ifsc.description: The IFSC number of the counterparty's account if applicable.

bsb_code.description: The BSB number of the counterparty's account if applicable.

route.description: Routing method for US/USD transfers. Defaults to `ach` for US-registered businesses and `fedwire` for non-US businesses.

bank_number.description: Brazilian bank identification code (COMPE). Returned for BR counterparties.

branch_code.description: Brazilian branch (agência) code. Returned for BR counterparties.

account_type.description: Bank account type. Returned for BR, CO, and CL counterparties. Defaults to `checking` for US ACH transfers.

tax_id.description:
Tax identification number.
Routed based on `bank_country` and recipient type:
- **BR**:
  - **Individual**: CPF (Cadastro de Pessoas Físicas). Accepted formats: `^\d{11}$` or `^\d{3}\.\d{3}\.\d{3}-\d{2}$`.
  - **Company**: CNPJ (Cadastro Nacional da Pessoa Jurídica). Accepted formats: `^\d{14}$` or `^\d{2}\.\d{3}\.\d{3}/\d{4}-\d{2}$`.
- **CO (company)**: NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria). Accepted format: `^\d{10}$`.
- **CL (individual, company)**: RUT (Rol Único Tributario).

national_id.description:
National identification number.
Specifies Colombian Cédula de Ciudadanía when `bank_country` is `CO` and `profile_type` is `personal`.

phone.description:
The phone number of the counterparty in [E.164](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/E.164) format.

Country-specific formats:
- **CO**: `+57` followed by 10 digits (`^\+?57\d{10}$`)
- **LK**: `+94` followed by 10 digits (`^\+?94\d{10}$`)
- **KR**: `+82` followed by 10 digits (`^\+?82\d{10}$`)

business_registration_id.description: Company registration number. Used for business LK counterparties.

recipient_charges.description:
Indicates the possibility of the recipient charges.

:::warning
This field is deprecated and should be disregarded.
It is returned for legacy purposes only.
:::

CounterpartyAddress.description: The address of the counterparty's account.

region.description: The name of the region (state or province), for example, Ontario for Canada.

country.description: The country of the counterparty, as a 2-letter [ISO 3166](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_ISO_3166_country_codes) code.

postcode.description: The postcode of the counterparty address.

id.description: The ID of the counterparty's card.

last_digits.description: The last four digits of the card number.

CountryCode.description: The counterparty's bank country, provided as a 2-letter [ISO 3166](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_ISO_3166_country_codes) code.

CountryCodeCard.description: The country of the card issuer, provided as a 2-letter [ISO 3166](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_ISO_3166_country_codes) code.

ProfileType.description:
The type of the counterparty.
Indicates whether the recipient is an individual or a company.
